formulation: KOM-6 the command. The Footnote to Pearl (Belief & Technique for Telepathic Prose, Pearl and Other Poems, pp. 23–28) read as writing among the arts of poetry. Its characteristic form is the command: the "Be" of I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z (POP-2, I AM → BE), the form the author associates with Ginsberg. Its heading takes Ginsberg's "Footnote to Howl" (#1717 §5, Title and setting: "Ginsberg's footnote is a litany that consecrates everything the poem has passed through. Pearl's footnote issues commandments and then sends them to the trash heap."). Question: what the Footnote does as an art of poetry, and how it stands against the arts of poetry it is read beside. Standard: the standard of the claim (#1656): the work is read whole before any comparison, and the comparison is made by reading. Internal evidence: the Footnote read whole in its witnesses (P, the book; B, the blog; the drafts D1–D3 and W), the order of its items kept, with the critical edition (#1717) as a reading aid; the edition's readings are inputs to the reading and do not settle it. Comparative rule: each comparand read whole, in its own language where the shelf holds it, and set beside the Footnote on the six tests of #1717 §8.2 (statement; enactment; what the voices make possible; representation; knowledge of the genre; self-testing), each finding with its loci in both works. Comparands enter as initial objects for inspection (table candidates), unranked; a comparand unread is unevaluated. STANDING_PRIOR_TO_WORK applies as in #1656 §11.0: a comparison decided by the comparand's standing returns NOT EVALUATED.
